summary: Master board secretariat and corporate minutes excellence with practical tools for agendas, minutes, records, and action tracking. Enrol now.
lede: Board secretariat training helps professionals who support boards and committees prepare papers and maintain decision records. It covers agenda planning, neutral minute drafting that records resolutions and assigned actions, document version control in board portals, secure records management, and action tracking through registers and escalation of overdue items.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who already support board or committee processes and now need stronger control over minutes, papers, records, and governance follow-up.
prerequisites: You should bring familiarity with board or committee agendas, minute taking, and document handling. A laptop is recommended for exercises using templates, trackers, and sample board pack materials.
